name: Vampire - Children of the Night (1/Day) - Attempts
description: Flavor text for attempts a action

results.text: The vampire raises a skeletal hand, moonlight glinting off its cold fingers as it summons the night's fury.
With a haunting whisper, the undead lord reaches out to the shadows, beckoning his children from the darkness.
A chilling wind howls as the vampire prepares to unleash the horde, their presence felt in every rustling leaf.
The vampire’s crimson eyes flare with eerie light, calling forth the beasts of the night to do its bidding.
Fangs glistening in the pale moonlight, the undead monster commands the creatures of shadow to answer his call.
